selection: 77 weekly DTA files; excludes three parallel surveys and alternate SAV copies.
weight_policy: Keep 2016-vote calibrated weight throughout the series. Validate published tables using their explicitly stated cover-page weights: weight before November 2020, weight_2020 after. Never choose weights by goodness of fit.

entries.title: Government-run health insurance
entries.question: Provide government-run health insurance to all Americans.
entries.weight: weight (2016 vote calibration) within each weekly wave; equal weight per observed wave within year
entries.question_note: Agree = +1; disagree = −1; not sure and skipped excluded. Annual points average observed weekly estimates equally, grouped by wave start year. 2019 and 2021 cover only part of the year; 2021 contains one wave. This item does not specify eliminating private insurance.

entries.title: Immigration: path to citizenship
entries.question: Create a path to citizenship for all undocumented immigrants.
entries.weight: weight (2016 vote calibration) within each weekly wave; equal weight per observed wave within year
entries.question_note: Agree = +1; disagree = −1. Not sure and skipped excluded. Annual points average observed weekly estimates equally, grouped by wave start year. 2019 and 2021 cover only part of the year; 2021 contains one wave.

entries.title: Immigration: citizenship for people brought here as children
entries.question: Create a path to citizenship for undocumented immigrants brought here as children.
entries.weight: weight (2016 vote calibration) within each weekly wave; equal weight per observed wave within year
entries.question_note: Agree = +1; disagree = −1. Not sure and skipped excluded. Annual points average observed weekly estimates equally, grouped by wave start year. 2019 and 2021 cover only part of the year; 2021 contains one wave.

entries.title: Immigration: deportation of undocumented immigrants
entries.question: Deport all undocumented immigrants.
entries.weight: weight (2016 vote calibration) within each weekly wave; equal weight per observed wave within year
entries.question_note: Agree = −1; disagree = +1. Not sure and skipped excluded. Annual points average observed weekly estimates equally, grouped by wave start year. 2019 and 2021 cover only part of the year; 2021 contains one wave.

notes: Democracy Fund + UCLA Nationscape. Four reviewed policy questions; 77 weekly surveys, July 2019–January 2021. Three parallel surveys excluded. Annual estimates describe observed weeks, not full calendar years. Counts are responses, not necessarily unique people.
